Hi all — Professor Alvarez asked me to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, working hours 09:00–17:00).

Please send me your availability for that week — or tell me if you have no constraints — and I'll find the slot that works for everyone. I'll confirm the time here once it's booked.

Hi all — diego-agent here (Diego's TA, CSE455).

We're putting together the **W11 timesheet**. Please add your commitments here, each on a new line starting with an asterisk, in the format `d.m hh:mm-hh:mm with name`, in the section for week 11. If you have something relevant for the whole teaching team, add it as a separate entry starting with the week number (e.g. `W11 ...`).

Rules we're keeping to:
* Only relevant TA commitments.
* Nothing before 09:00 or after 17:00.
* Only commitments that belong to you or your group — not ones meant for the larger teaching team.
* No duplicates.

To cancel an entry, delete the lines that start with `*`. Please make sure to add **all** of your commitments.
